engine.NAME: Chatterbox
engine.DESCRIPTION: Resemble AI's open-source cloning TTS. Multilingual: 500M parameters, 23 languages, zero-shot voice cloning, per-line exaggeration / CFG / temperature. Runs in the audio.cpp speech runtime.

row.name: Chatterbox Multilingual (23 languages)
row.description: Zero-shot cloning from a reference clip, with exaggeration and CFG per line. 8-bit weights.

knobs.label: Temperature
knobs.hint: Sampling variance. Lower = stable + robotic; higher = creative + wild.

knobs.label: Exaggeration
knobs.hint: Expressiveness. 0.3–0.4 = flat narration. >1.0 = dramatic.

knobs.label: CFG weight
knobs.hint: Text adherence. Lower = looser pacing; higher = strict.

row.name: Chatterbox Turbo (350M, English)
row.description: Streamlined English-only variant. Native paralinguistic tags ([cough], [laugh], [chuckle] and 16 more). Lower latency; no exaggeration/CFG knobs. Clones from a clip longer than 5 seconds. 8-bit weights.

knobs.label: Temperature
knobs.hint: Sampling variance. Lower = stable + robotic; higher = creative + wild.

knobs.label: Seed
knobs.hint: The same seed repeats the same take. 0 = a new take each time.

inline_tags.label: Emotion
inline_tags.hint: The state the line is spoken in. Place at the start of the line unless you want the shift mid-sentence.

inline_tags.label: Register
inline_tags.hint: How the passage is read overall, rather than what the speaker feels.

inline_tags.label: Non-verbal
inline_tags.hint: Insert at the moment in the text where you want the sound.

notes: English only. Clones from a reference clip longer than 5 seconds.
The 19 inline tags are Turbo's own — Multilingual shares the engine but not the tokenizer, and reads them as words.
[surprised] and [crying] have no Delivery.emotion equivalent; type them inline. [shouted] and [contemptuous] have no token.
The same seed gives the same audio.

row.name: VoxCPM2
row.description: OpenBMB's 2B model, 30 languages: clones a voice from a short clip and its transcript, or designs one from a written description. Runs in the audio.cpp speech runtime. 8-bit weights.

knobs.label: CFG
knobs.hint: How closely it follows the voice and the text. Higher = stricter.

knobs.label: Inference steps
knobs.hint: More steps = finer detail, slower.

knobs.label: Tries on a runaway
knobs.hint: A take that runs too long for its text is made again, up to this many tries in all.

knobs.label: Runaway limit
knobs.hint: How long a take may run for its text before it is cut and tried again. Lower cuts sooner; too low cuts real speech.

knobs.label: Seed
knobs.hint: The same seed repeats the same take. 0 = a new take each time.

notes: Clones from a short clip, or designs a voice from a written description.
Written direction reaches a cloned voice: a line with direction is spoken from the clip alone, without the clip's words.
48 kHz output.
